caption: The video captures a hydraulic press rig with a polished cylindrical metal ram centered above a yellow-and-black striped platform heaped with broken red brick fragments. An upright reddish brick piece with a dark soot-stained base stands right of the pile, touching the ram. The ram descends, compressing the upright piece against the rubble while the hazard columns, gray housing, camera mount, and yellow cord remain fixed. A thin crack and brief motion blur appear on the brick as it is squeezed. The block shatters, sending reddish fragments and dust outward to the right with strong blur, leaving only rubble beneath the ram. The ram continues to rest on the lowered debris pile as scattered pieces shift toward the platform edge.
relations: Polished ram descends onto upright soot-based brick, squeezing it against rubble while background stays fixed.
Under compression, a thin crack and brief blur appear on the brick before it shatters.
Shattering sends reddish fragments and dust outward to the right with strong motion blur.
Ram continues resting on lowered debris as scattered pieces shift toward platform edge.
